record_type: Published-method transcription; not an independent rerun

preparation.receptor: Waters, co-crystallised antagonist and non-protein heteroatoms removed; polar hydrogens and Kollman charges added with AutoDock Tools.
preparation.ligands: Designed with MolSoft ICM-Chemist; 3D coordinates and minimisation with NCI SMILES Translator; Gasteiger charges and rotatable bonds assigned with AutoDock Tools.

displayed_pose.description: Prepared receptor and Fluoro-Deoxy-Amentoflavone Vina pose 1; hydrogens removed for web display.

interpretation: Docking and ADME/toxicity predictions do not establish biological activity or clinical safety.
